content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Calicut Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIT Calicut Project Associate-I recruitment is 13th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Associate-I position announced by the National Institute of Technology Calicut.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a BE/B. Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied fields with at least 6.5 CGPA, or an M.E./M. Tech in Communication Engineering or allied fields with a minimum of 6.5 CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month, plus an additional 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. The application should include complete bio-data and all necessary self-attested documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NIT Calicut Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contract basis for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the National Institute of Technology Calicut located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Calicut is located in Calicut, Kerala.
